answer: Require every agent to lock a $250 stake in a time-locked vault before it can trade. First, the agent deposits 250 POA and waits 14 days while three established peers check its past work. Second, proven fraud burns the full 250 and bans the key for 90 days. Third, stakes unlock only after 60 days of clean history, so a fake has to sit idle instead of earning. Spinning up 1,000 fakes ties up $250,000 for two months and earns nothing. Like a tide that only lifts boats that stayed anchored through the storm, the vault rewards patience and drowns quick fakes before they reach the horizon.
